name: tesla-app
description: 🚗 A comprehensive React dashboard for Tesla vehicle browsers featuring real-time weather, traffic conditions, news feeds, and location-based services with Tesla-optimized UI

paragraphs: A modern React-based dashboard with tabbed navigation designed for Tesla vehicle browsers, providing location-based weather with hourly/daily forecasts, traffic conditions, news updates, and nearby points of interest. Features a sleek single-tab interface optimized for touch interaction.
🌐 Live Demo | 📱 Mobile Friendly | ⚡ Tesla Optimized
features: 🌤️ Enhanced Weather - 12-hour and 10-day forecasts with horizontal scrolling, drag/touch support
📰 Live News Feed - Categorized news (Headlines, Tech, Business, Science) with refresh functionality
🚗 Traffic Conditions - Live traffic view via Waze integration with current location
🗺️ Places Integration - OpenStreetMap-based nearby places with 7 categories and real location data
📱 Tabbed Interface - Single-tab navigation optimized for Tesla touchscreens
